lines.t: I was running in circles, trying to find my way
I kept making the same mistakes I made
Like my life was on replay, I thought my chance was over
Thought I'd gone too far, carried all this guilt inside me
Like a weight around my heart, every door fell shut on me
Every prayer just hit the floor, but in the silence I heard you say
You're not who you were before
It's not the end, yeah, it's not the end, yeah
Even though you pulled me in
When I thought I was too broke
And you fixed me up again
I was lost inside the noise
Every wrong turn I've been through
I gave up on myself
But you never gave up too
I thought you'd turn me away
Because of all I'd done
Every promise that I broke
Every place I tried to run
I was hiding in the shadows, afraid to face the truth
But you kept on loving me, you called me to you
I thought I knew what you'd say about all the wrong I did
But your voice cuts through the silence
Like a hope I couldn't miss
It's not the end, it's not the end
Even though you pulled me in
When I thought I was too broken, you fixed me up again
I was lost inside of the noise, every wrong turn I've been through
I gave up on myself, but you never gave up too
I stopped running, I let go, and my loss became close
What I thought was the end
Was you calling me home
You never gave up on me
Even when I made the wrong choice
You kept calling out to me
Even when I ignored your voice
When I tried to push you aside
You still held out your hand
When I was broken you lifted me up
When I was weak you helped me stand
It's not the end
I see it now
Your love was stronger than my doubt
I'm still here because you are
Because you kept me in your heart
